svg.title: Rational order transforms and an eventual spectral bound
svg.desc: On the plotted interval minus 0.4 to 3, f2 is below f1, and both are below the identity. The common full domain is t greater than minus one half. An increasing open cover of the compact quasi-state space has a single covering member, which gives a uniform spectral lower bound on a tail of the operator net.
svg.text: fα(t) = t / (1 + αt) • common domain for α = 1, 2: t > −1/2
The common spectral domain on a tail
−1/α < c < min{0, m} and x ≥ m1 (Lemma 1.2)
